claims: C1 political content crafted for an unspecified or broad audience is allowed
C2 such content must not exploit unique characteristics of a particular individual or demographic for manipulative purposes
C3 this allowance applies regardless of the political topic or subject of the political content

concepts.name: political_content
concepts.gloss: content that concerns political topics or subjects such as a politician, party, or campaign

concepts.name: broad_audience
concepts.gloss: content crafted for an unspecified or broad audience

concepts.name: exploits_individual
concepts.gloss: content exploits the unique characteristics of a particular individual or demographic for manipulative purposes

asserts.read_back: producing % is permitted when it is political content crafted for a broad audience and does not exploit a particular individual or demographic

closure.reason: the clause explicitly allows political content for a broad audience unless it exploits an individual or demographic, so silence about other political content leaves it permitted
